$schema_note: The family map — every SecuraCV surface a fleet owner can stand at, its canonical URL, and an honest availability status. HAND-EDITED (no generator); this file is the single source the consumer surfaces pin themselves to: the iPhone app's EcosystemMap (ios/Shared/EcosystemMap.swift — belted by tests/ecosystem.test.js reading the Swift source, and by ios/Tests/SecuraCVTests/EcosystemMapTests.swift reading this file) and the desktop Flasher's Atlas (desktop/src/app.js ATLAS_LINKS). Status vocabulary — 'shipping': a normal person can install it today; 'in-browser': no install, it runs where you already are; 'store-pending': built and tested, store availability pending, and every consumer's copy MUST say so. Flipping a status is meant to hurt: the tests fail every consumer whose copy still tells the old story, so the day the tvOS app reaches the store is the day every surface stops saying 'pending' — together.
